subject: gk
question: Article 19(1)(b) of the Indian Constitution is related to which of the following?

options.text: To assemble peaceably and without arms
To move freely throughout the territory of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**to assemble peaceably and without arms**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Article 19(1)(b) of the Indian Constitution is related to the right to assemble peaceably and without arms. 
 
• Freedom of speech and expression
